name: Nordic Crypto
title: Nordic Crypto data model
note: These schemas are copied from schema/*.schema.json at build time. Field names are the stored names. Reader tips and newsletter subscriber addresses are private Cloudflare D1 stores and are not described field by field.

private.summary: Reader tips. The text of a tip is not in the public files and is not served under /api/v1/.
Newsletter subscriber addresses. They are not in the public files and are not served under /api/v1/.

collections.title: News stories
collections.description: Stories in data/news.json. status is the editorial state: pending, published, rejected or merged. The public API lists published stories that have a summary. Editor fields stay in the file and are left out of /api/v1/.

api.note: The 25 newest stories, notifier fields only
NO, SE, DK, FI, IS, NORDIC or EU

relations.note: Other outlets on the same event
Our headlines, when we wrote them
Front-page blurb, when one is written

collections.title: Events
collections.description: Calendar events. data/events.json is the working list, archive/events.json is what the public calendar keeps, and data/events_backfill.json is the previous-events backfill. sponsored is null, false, true, or the sponsor's name, and is never Kaupr. The calendar status upcoming, ongoing or past is computed from start and end and is not stored.

api.note: Public events, soonest start first, including past events
Finished calendar events plus the backfill

relations.note: Null, false, true, or the sponsor's name
A removed duplicate points at the kept id

derived.name: calendar_status
derived.description: Not stored. upcoming: start is in the future. ongoing: start is in the past and end is still ahead (an event with no end is never ongoing). past: the event has ended. The same split is published as /api/v1/events/upcoming.json, the ongoing array, and /api/v1/events/past.json.

collections.title: Sources
collections.description: News outlets and event sources in sources.json. type is how the fetcher reads the outlet. coverage is national, regional, local or justice. Kaupr is a news source and is never a sponsor.

api.note: Outlets, search terms and event sources

collections.title: Newsletters
collections.description: Published issues in newsletter/published/issues.json. Drafts under newsletter/issues/ are not part of this schema. Subscriber addresses are a private store and are not in this file.

api.note: Published issues, without the HTML body
One issue, including text and HTML

collections.title: Sponsors
collections.description: There is no sponsors file. A sponsor is the sponsored field on an event: null or false when there is no sponsor, true when it is sponsored without a named sponsor, or the sponsor's name. Kaupr is never a sponsor.

collections.title: Academia
collections.description: Courses, student groups, publications and research groups in data/academia.json. The public page shows rows whose status is approved.

collections.title: Books
collections.description: Published books about bitcoin, crypto or blockchain by Nordic authors, or about the Nordic countries, in data/books.json. Titles stay in the original language. about is our one-line description in English.

collections.title: Markets
collections.description: Nordic exchange prices written at build time to /api/v1/markets.json. This is not a file in data/. Market data, not investment advice. quote is NOK, SEK, DKK or EUR. Nothing is converted between currencies.

api.note: One base asset, such as BTC
CC0 icon when the set includes the asset

collections.title: Profiles
collections.description: Public profile links in data/profiles.json, keyed by who's who id. Each link needs a source_url that shows it belongs to that person or organisation. status published is what the site shows.

api.note: Profiles taken from the published who's who

collections.title: Who's who
collections.description: People and organisations in data/orgchart.json, the relations between them, and a short regulation note per country. status published is what the public page and the API show.

relations.note: whoswho_id and org_id on a developer

collections.title: Talks
collections.description: Public talks on bitcoin, cryptocurrencies and blockchain in the Nordic countries, in data/talks.json. description is ours. The other details come from the platform at source_url. A field the platform did not state is null.

api.note: NO, SE, DK, FI, IS, FO, GL or AX

relations.note: Null when the talk could not be dated or placed

collections.title: Developers
collections.description: Open-source developers in data/developers.json. Only public professional information: no addresses and no private details. The public page shows status published.

collections.title: Illustrations
collections.description: Licensed pictures that may be assigned to a story, in data/illustrations.json. kind is original, commons or official-press. A newspaper photograph is never stored here.

api.note: Picture records and the assignment rules

collections.title: Portraits
collections.description: Portrait files for the who's who, keyed by entity id, in data/images.json. Each record names the file, the author and the licence.

api.note: Portraits and logos published with the who's who

collections.title: Outlet logos
collections.description: Outlet marks in assets/img/logos/logos.json, keyed by id. review ok is what the public API shows. A missing review counts as ok. pending is included only in a preview build. rejected is never shown. The marks are the publishers' trademarks, shown only to identify the source of a headline.

api.note: logo and logo_url on each outlet
source_logo and source_logo_url on each story

collections.title: Changelog
collections.description: Site changes in changelog.json (new pages, sections and features, not the daily news). review pending keeps an entry off the public page until it has a date.

collections.title: Rules map
collections.description: The regulation map behind /rules/, in rules.json. Every node points at a primary source. review approved is what the public page shows.

collections.title: Visitor stats
collections.description: Aggregate visits and page views in data/stats.json, from Cloudflare Web Analytics. No IP addresses, user agents, paths, referrers or countries. Days are UTC. Weeks are ISO weeks.

api.note: The same counts the stats page shows

collections.title: Crowdfunding
collections.description: The closed crowdfunding pilot in data/crowdfunding.json. Nordic Crypto does not hold keys or funds. The file has no donor data and no balances. demo true marks an example, not a live campaign.

api.note: The curated list. No balances and no donor data.

collections.title: Budget
collections.description: Monthly hosting and domain costs in data/budget.json. The figures exclude labour. amount is the monthly figure in currency.

collections.title: Article archive
collections.description: Stories the public site has shown, in archive/articles.json, including when a story was removed. removal_reason stays null in this public file.

collections.title: Headline translations
collections.description: Our headlines by story id, in data/title_i18n.json. The source headline stays on the story. Keys are nn, nb, sv, da, fi and is, and only for languages that are not already the source headline.

collections.title: Front-page blurbs
collections.description: Front-page blurbs by story id, in data/frontpage_blurbs.json. en is ours, in English. The Nordic site languages sit beside it when a translation is published.

collections.title: Event descriptions
collections.description: Organiser descriptions and our translations, by event id, in data/event_description_i18n.json. source is the original wording. A language key is present only when that translation is written.

collections.title: Event redirects
collections.description: Merged duplicate events in data/event_redirects.json. Each key is a removed id and each value is the id that was kept. The old calendar URL refreshes to the kept event.

collections.title: Regulation videos
collections.description: Country explainer slots in data/regulation-videos.json. status scripts_ready means the script and storyboard exist and the MP4 is not committed yet.
